name: claude-skills
description: Personal Claude Code skills for Rails + React projects and their React Native / Expo mobile apps: dev-skills (topic skills for uploads, authorization, DB performance, text input, idempotency, web security, frontend quality, deploy safety, domain integrity, notifications, plus implement-pr, pre-pr-check and feature-judge) and mobile-skills (release compatibility, offline and lifecycle, mobile security, push and deep links, mobile UI quality).

plugins.name: dev-skills
plugins.description: Implementation rules + review checklists for uploads/CDN, authorization/multi-tenancy, DB performance, hostile text input, idempotency/retries, web security, frontend quality, deploy safety, domain integrity and notifications/integrations, plus implement-pr, pre-pr-check and feature-judge workflows.

plugins.name: mobile-skills
plugins.description: Implementation rules + review checklists for React Native / Expo apps: release and version compatibility, offline and app lifecycle, mobile security, push notifications and deep links, mobile UI quality. Install it in projects that have a mobile app, next to dev-skills.
